為る [する] (common)

Writings: 為る
Readings: する
Furigana: 為[す]る

Auxiliary verb; intransitive verb; suffix; suru verb - included; transitive verb

  1. to do; to carry out; to perform
  2. to cause to become; to make (into); to turn (into)
  3. to serve as; to act as; to work as
  … and 14 more senses

Synonyms:
  飲む  [のむ]
     to drink
  食う  [くう]
     to eat
  有る  [ある]
     to be
  来る  [くる]
     to come (spatially or temporally)
  感ずる  [かんずる]
     to feel
